name: Iajuddin Ahmed
contribution: Iajuddin Ahmed served as Bangladesh's president and briefly became chief adviser of the caretaker government during the 2006–07 political crisis.
context: Bangladesh's disputed electoral transition, caretaker government, and emergency declaration in 2006–07.
impact: His dual role exposed institutional tensions between the presidency, caretaker administration, and electoral legitimacy.
highlight: Iajuddin Ahmed was president and caretaker chief adviser during Bangladesh's 2006–07 political crisis.
seoTitle: Iajuddin Ahmed: President and Caretaker Chief Adviser
seoDescription: Learn about Iajuddin Ahmed's presidency and brief role as caretaker chief adviser during Bangladesh's 2006–07 crisis.
shortAnswer: Iajuddin Ahmed was Bangladesh's president who also served briefly as chief adviser during the 2006–07 caretaker crisis.
